bundle.longDescription: Desktop application for promoting explicitly selected, already-approved subsystem commits into a chosen branch of the main-system repository. The tool performs the promotion itself: it copies the selected files' subsystem content onto the target branch in your local clone, merges the manifest dependency changes, and records a provenance commit. The deployment regenerates the lockfile. Pushing and opening a pull request are an explicit opt-in, and a direct push to a protected branch is never performed. It adds no files to the target repositories.
